protocol.grid: frozen v3 fresh unseen grid, 34 cases (policy sha joint-planner-fast-v3, unchanged)
protocol.timing: in-process full = load+setup+execute+extract+cleanup; medians over 3 fresh-process reps (9 reps for shallow low-ms cells); phases are the worker's own phase accounting
protocol.native_arms: hybrid_fast, batch_deep (deep only), rf, corr (only where its gate is active, i.e. deep Q<=2)
protocol.aligned_pgdg: pgdg_align = panel_pgdg_align --arm pgdg_auto (compiled/offline + sparse rank-LUT + correction prefix)

deep 300k.interpretation: planner_vs_native_only < 1 means the selector improves on the best native arm by routing to aligned PGD-G where it is faster; planner_vs_aligned_pgdg < 1 means the selector is faster than always routing to aligned PGD-G, thanks to the native deep/other wins.
